claim: Every piece of context handed to a model carries its source and an explicit injection_disposition ("clear" vs. untrusted) before assembly — the model never has to guess what it can trust.

steps.label: every item declares a source and a disposition
steps.evidence: the untrusted item is still included — labelled, not removed
steps.note: The job is not to decide what is safe. It is to make sure nothing arrives unlabelled.

steps.label: an item with text but no source
steps.note: Context with no provenance is context the model has to guess about.

steps.label: an item with no disposition
steps.note: Absent is not the same as clear. Defaulting it would make the dangerous case the quiet one.

steps.label: a disposition outside the allowed vocabulary
steps.note: A free-text trust label is a trust label nobody can enforce.
